clusters.pick_reason: #2600's changeset addresses two symptoms of the same root cause: it settles parked JSON-mode POSTs on close() AND clears _requestToStreamMapping (previously left intact), which #2692 does not touch — an unfixed correlation-map leak lets a send() suspended in eventStore.storeEvent() resume against a retired correlation after close(), leaking the response and correlation for the process lifetime. #2600 also states it validated the fix against both WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransport and NodeStreamableHTTPServerTransport (which wraps it), while #2692 only describes the Web-standard path. #2692's per-request JSON-RPC -32000 error grouped by stream is a more precise settlement payload than #2600's blanket 404, so that response-shape refinement should be folded into #2600 before merge.
